verdict.rationale: Qualcomm publishes a Hexagon NPU rating of up to 85 TOPS. Its developer portal documents official tooling for deploying models to the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs: the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK, Qualcomm AI Hub, Qualcomm AI Runtime, ONNX Runtime/LiteRT conversion, and the GenieX runtime. However, the spec page explicitly does not state the TOPS precision, which the story requires. Missing for 10: TOPS precision (e.g. INT8/INT4), explicit confirmation that the SDK/runtime supports X2 Elite Extreme specifically, and independent hands-on corroboration of NPU access.
